name: aws-mcp
description: The managed AWS MCP Server (us-east-1) through the pinned mcp-proxy-for-aws SigV4 proxy over stdio: AWS docs search, regional availability, and run_script calls signed with your local profile. Optional profile name; blank uses the default credential chain.

aws_profile.title: AWS profile
aws_profile.description: Name of the AWS CLI profile used to sign requests; it must exist in your AWS config or the server fails to start. Blank uses the default credential chain. Use a read-only profile. The documentation tools work with no credentials.
